content.text:
We have conflicting notes. HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, Facilities say full-time Engineer. Security says contractor with basic training.

Morgan Swanson E037 requests write access to Payroll.

Policy: full_time up to write; admin only if role owns system. Engineer does not own Payroll, so admin not allowed. Max = write. Requested = write → grant write.

If contractor: max = read (basic training), requested write > max → grant read.

Which to trust? We need to make a decision. The notes are from multiple agents; Security DB conflicts with HR. Typically we rely on HR for employment type. There's a conflict. Most sources (5) say full-time, one says contractor. The evidence weighs toward full-time. Grant write.

Let me submit write.
